note: GRIME region 'Piney Green, NC' — real-data pipeline (DEM→streams→candidates→stream mask (sites confined to ±150 m of mapped OSM/NHD waterways)→region-appropriate real parameters→shipped scoring, math unchanged). Width curve: Bieger et al. 2015 JAWRA Table 3, Atlantic Plain. Flood: SIR 2014-5030 HR4 (I24H50Y: NOAA Atlas 14). NC Coastal Plain (SIR 2014-5030 HR4; I24H50Y from NOAA Atlas 14 at region center)

bank_slope_score.source: NC OneMap / NC DPS DEM03 statewide lidar-derived 3.125-ft (0.953 m) elevations (perpendicular 50 m transect; robust 5 m bank-rise metric); unavailable profiles use the region 10 m 3DEP DEM-gradient fallback

beach_dist_km.source: haversine to region ref: Wrightsville Beach (shipped NC reference)

channel_width_score.source: Bieger 2015 APL width curve on DEM drainage area → shipped width curve

cso_density.source: EPA ECHO open CSO/TCS outfall PF coordinates states=NC, Cauchy proximity

ej_index.source: Census ACS C17002+B03002 two-component demographic index, percentile-ranked within region

estuary_dist_km.source: haversine to region ref: Pamlico Sound (shipped NC reference)

flood_q10_cfs.source: USGS SIR 2014-5030 Table 7 HR4 (NC Coastal Plain; I24H50Y from NOAA Atlas 14 at region center)

flow_velocity_ms.source: Manning (region DEM/D8) blended with EROM continuity (shipped M4 logic)

land_ownership.fallback_reason: no containing parcel owner returned; shipped unknown ownership 0.5 used
land_ownership.source: NC OneMap statewide parcels (NC Parcels Transformer) ownname

litter_complaint_density.source: no public machine-readable litter/illegal-dumping feed for this region

navigable_dist_m.source: USACE/BTS NWN (NTAD): no navigable segment within this bbox (+2 km) — computed absence, gate passes all sites

npdes_points.source: EPA ECHO active NPDES outfalls states=NC (types NPD/GPC/NGP; statuses ADC/EFF/EXP), per catchment

population_density.source: Census ACS 2022 B01003 block groups (bbox, multi-county), area-weighted

protected_area_score.source: USGS PAD-US 4.1 state GDB; states=NC; shipped designation-weighted proximity curve

road_density_km_km2.source: OSM drive network (osmnx, cached) clipped per catchment

seasonal_cv.source: CV of NHDPlus EROM monthly flows per COMID

superfund_score.source: EPA DataMap SEMS active sites states=NC (non-archived, georeferenced), shipped 500 m inverse-distance curve

tourism_amenity_density.source: OSM leisure/tourism query unavailable — documented fallback

tri_facility_density.source: EPA DataMap TRI open facilities states=NC (preferred decimal or packed-DMS recovery), per catchment

velocity_feasibility.source: shipped step curve on the computed velocity

velocity_transport_favorability.source: scored form of flow_velocity_ms inside the Flow family — peaked Gaussian exp(-((v-0.9)/0.6)^2), model.json curves.velocity_transport_favorability; construct: transport/delivery favorability, deliberately distinct from velocity_feasibility (device operability)

water_intake_score.source: NC OneMap / NC DEQ SWAP public water supply sources (source_typ='Surface Water'), shipped exp(-d/10km) curve
